description: This file defines a Java interface 'JsonException' that specifies common methods for all JSON-related exceptions within the project, including methods for retrieving error code, description, and hyperlink information.

classes.name: JsonException
classes.description: Interface defining common methods for JSON-related exceptions, including error code retrieval, optional description, and URI for more info.

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the error code that uniquely identifies this JSON exception.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns an optional description for the exception, intended for user reporting.

methods.name: getHref
methods.description: Returns an optional URI linking to further information about this exception.
